def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = 6
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find contiguous colored runs on each outer edge.
    runs = []
    for side in ("top", "bottom", "left", "right"):
        cells = []
        n = w if side in ("top", "bottom") else h
        for i in range(n):
            r, c = ((0, i) if side == "top" else
                    (h - 1, i) if side == "bottom" else
                    (i, 0) if side == "left" else (i, w - 1))
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                cells.append((i, grid[r][c]))
        groups = []
        for i, color in cells:
            if groups and i == groups[-1][1] + 1 and color == groups[-1][2]:
                groups[-1] = (groups[-1][0], i, color)
            else:
                groups.append((i, i, color))
        for a, b, color in groups:
            if b - a + 1 >= 2:
                runs.append((side, a, b, color))

    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 1, 2)]

    # Pair parallel edge runs of the same color and length.
    pairs = []
    for i, x in enumerate(runs):
        for y in runs[i + 1:]:
            sx, ax, bx, cx = x
            sy, ay, by, cy = y
            if cx != cy or bx - ax != by - ay:
                continue
            if {sx, sy} in ({"top", "bottom"}, {"left", "right"}):
                pairs.append((x, y))

    for r, c, color in markers:
        axis = None
        chosen = None
        for x, y in pairs:
            sx, ax, bx, col = x
            sy, ay, by, _ = y
            coord = c if sx in ("top", "bottom") else r
            coord2 = c if sy in ("top", "bottom") else r
            if ax <= coord <= bx:
                chosen = (x, y, coord, coord2)
                break
            if ay <= coord2 <= by:
                chosen = (y, x, coord2, coord)
                break
        if chosen is None:
            continue

        source, target, coord, target_coord = chosen
        ss, sa, sb, _ = source
        ts, ta, tb, _ = target
        mapped = ta + (coord - sa)

        out[r][c] = 4
        if ss in ("top", "bottom"):
            start = 0 if ss == "top" else h - 1
            end = 0 if ts == "top" else h - 1
            step = 1 if end > start else -1
            rr = start
            while rr != end:
                out[rr][mapped] = color
                rr += step
        else:
            start = 0 if ss == "left" else w - 1
            end = 0 if ts == "left" else w - 1
            step = 1 if end > start else -1
            cc = start
            while cc != end:
                out[mapped][cc] = color
                cc += step

    return out
